source_report.claim: Removing the outer number in each repeated square leaves an identical number grid.

scope: Four PGP-verified OutGuess message bodies embedded in LP1-10 through LP1-13; separately exclude the two visible five-by-five LP1 magic squares as an interpretation of the report.
ring_rule: Find the sole seven-line ASCII diagram bounded by a row of sixteen equal digits. Remove the top and bottom rows and the first and last character of each of its five internal rows, preserving every other byte and original orientation. Read the three remaining numeric rows as a three-by-three decimal matrix. Do not rotate, reflect, normalize numbers, or search alternate crop widths.
